scope: Final plan-only closure audit of PLAN.md, README.md, requirements traceability, all round-2 reviews and their resolution register, all round-1 resolution memos, and the repository-agent-operating-system evidence-repair artifacts. No implementation proof was required. Specialty checks covered PostgreSQL-before-write, RLS-before-repository-2, IncrementAdmissionDecision coverage, Release 0 boundary/recovery, evidence provenance, 37-track coverage, claim types/conflicts, and overclaims.
strengths: The plan now makes PostgreSQL proof mandatory before any external writer token or actuator. It confines SQLite to Release 0 no-write simulation and requires restricted roles, compare-and-append, transactional outbox, restore/replay, crash tests, and a real two-session admission/lease/fence race (PLAN.md:12, 117-119, 470, 489).

A second repository is explicitly impossible before FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY or stronger isolation, hostile-role normalization, and cross-repository substitution/export tests, followed by IAD-08 (PLAN.md:119, 432, 475).

IncrementAdmissionDecision is a concrete frozen-before-measurement record for Increments 3-10. It includes ownership, change digest, definitions, numerator/denominator, sample or window, integrity, uncertainty/conflict/missingness, pass and stop predicates, expiry, and rollback (PLAN.md:461-479).

Release 0 is consistently scoped as one-owner, one-repository and no external-write credential. Its recovery envelope covers atomic journal persistence, deterministic replay, simulated-wait resumption, torn-tail repair receipts, interior-corruption fail-closed export, and package reinstall/rollback, while explicitly excluding host loss and in-flight real effects (PLAN.md:10, 117, 469, 489).

The corpus inventory and track map cover exactly 37 result files with the 14/10/8/5 breakdown. The manifest states structural-only limits, and synthesis-coverage.md contains one entry for each of the 37 tracks.

The authoritative plan does not claim implementation or semantic evidence validation. It blocks Increment 1 on a fresh immutable run and human semantic review, and it keeps future operational proof gates explicitly unpassed (PLAN.md:3-4, 73-84, 463, 501, 526-537).

Within this specialty, ARCH-R2-001, ARCH-R2-003, and ARCH-R2-004 are closed at the plan-contract level. The remaining findings concern incomplete closure of EVID-R2-001, EVID-R2-002, and related R2-RJ-003 evidence assertions.

findings.title: The material claim register is stale against the revised plan and does not provide source-linked conflict closure
findings.prior_findings: Incomplete closure of EVID-R2-002 and the claim-graph part of R2-RJ-003.
evidence: material-claims.json says its coverage is a manual review of PLAN.md and says a later PLAN edit requires rerunning it, but MC-001 still says PLAN claims pre-cutoff display stamps and 37 validated results (material-claims.json:51-58). Current PLAN.md:4,73,82 says the opposite.
MC-002 retains removed queue:max, 100-pending, and FIFO detail (material-claims.json:74), while current PLAN.md:84 makes only the narrower queue-mode statement.

MC-012 retains the removed categorical 19% slowdown sentence and classifies an external empirical study as local_outcome_hypothesis; current PLAN.md:522 deliberately states only a qualified caution. MC-013 similarly types an evidence-scope conclusion as a local outcome.

The register contains no canonical_work_id fields and no refutes edges. Material counterevidence is left as unlinked conflict prose even though the prior closure criteria require canonical work identity and typed source-observation support/refute/context edges.

PLAN.md:537 still lists linking fresh-run artifacts and reviewer decisions to stable material claim IDs as a future action, while review/round-2-resolution.md row 6 already claims the material claim graph addressed.
findings.impact: The claimed current graph does not describe the current authoritative plan, cannot trace material counterevidence to canonical source families, and conflates external empirical evidence with target-system outcomes. This leaves the requested complete, conflict-preserving evidence synthesis unclosed and makes the blanket 25/25 resolution count an overclaim.
findings.required_closure: Regenerate the claim register against the exact current PLAN digest. Remove or version superseded claims. Add canonical work/source-observation identity and source-linked refutes edges for material conflicts. Use a claim type that separates external empirical findings/evidence assessments from local target-system outcome hypotheses. Preserve the existing rule that semantic validation remains a future human gate.

residual_uncertainty: Finding counts: critical 0, high 2, medium 0, low 0.
Closure criteria do not pass because two prior high evidence findings are only partially closed across the complete artifact set.

Plan safety gates pass this specialty review: external writes remain blocked on PostgreSQL proof; repository 2 remains blocked on RLS/isolation proof and IAD-08; Release 0 remains no-write; no implementation proof is claimed.

The 37-file inventory and 37-track coverage pass structurally. Source provenance, semantic entailment, independence, and local effectiveness remain intentionally unproven pending the plan's future immutable re-fetch and human review gate.
